articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: They Licensed the Remix Back to You
articles.dek: UMG hands ElevenLabs the mash-up keys the same week Suno drops “industry partner” v6 — while Universal is still suing somebody.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Mouse Hired an Empire
articles.dek: deadmau5 leaves CAA for Independent Artist Group. The next flex isn’t a festival slot — it’s the software, the series, the IP stack.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Just Sports Means Equity
articles.dek: Sydney Sweeney didn’t endorse Novig. She joined the cap table. Celebrity A&R grew up.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Stars for the Floor
articles.dek: This week’s horoscope, for whoever is still in last night’s mascara.
articles.imageAlt: A 1976 Eisenhower dollar, moon reverse. Photo: AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Shoes Come Off
articles.dek: Afters start in the hallway. Boots by the door. Keep them on and you’re still at the club.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Mini Held Nothing
articles.dek: Bag the size of a tin. Lip, key, phone in the boot. Boys asked where she put her stuff.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Mezzanine
articles.dek: Massive Attack, 1998. The 4am record. Not a costume. A temperature.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Sticker on the Lens
articles.dek: They banned phones at the door and still posted the story. The no-phone night is a flyer.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Bathroom Line
articles.dek: The floor is for the photograph. You go to the stall to finish the night.
articles.imageAlt: Cookies nightclub restroom, Berlin. Photo: Siegfy, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Are We Still Going
articles.dek: RA is a brochure. Dice is a receipt. The night starts at 4:12 in a thread.
articles.imageAlt: A phone on a table. Photo: Santeri Viinamäki, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Flyer on the Fridge
articles.dek: The boys grade vinyl. She kept the xerox that smelled like the room.
articles.imageAlt: A 1992 Ultim-8 rave flyer. Photo: ultim8 raves, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Incense Before the Aux
articles.dek: Scent is the first DJ. The aux is late.
articles.imageAlt: Smoke from an incense stick. Photo: AntanO, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Pants Stay On
articles.dek: Nine people signed a petition to ban Hello Kitty pajama pants at raves. Glasgow is printing the cat on the flyer anyway.
articles.imageAlt: Pink pajama pants on a warehouse dancefloor, flash photo.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: You Are (Love)
articles.dek: Riscape’s first Club Copy cassette. Four tracks. September 18. Pre-order if you want one you can flip.
articles.imageAlt: You Are (Love) circular dusk cityscape artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The New Sound of the Greek Underground
articles.dek: Ioannis Rigas grew up on piano in Athens. The clubs came later. This is him now.
articles.imageAlt: Riscape

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She Showed Up
articles.dek: Mary’s Underground threw a Lorde night. Then Lorde walked in and skipped the green room.
articles.imageAlt: A concert crowd facing the stage. Photo: Alpharockindia, CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Fancy That
articles.dek: PinkPantheress, nine tracks, twenty minutes. No features. She still doesn’t want a long outro.
articles.imageAlt: A TDK cassette, overhead. Photo: Scott Schiller, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Eusexua
articles.dek: Twigs made a word for the second before you come back into your body. Album three. Out today.
articles.imageAlt: People on a dancefloor. Photo: CC0 / Wikimedia Commons.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She's Never Been to Berghain
articles.dek: Rosalía, Björk, Yves Tumor, the LSO. German in the first breath. Then she said she’s never been inside.
articles.imageAlt: Graffiti steel doors, Berlin. Photo by Michael Mayer, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Labubu on the Strap
articles.dek: Lisa clipped a gremlin to a Louis. Dua doubled up. Reseller tabs went ugly. The floor did not care.
articles.imageAlt: A clear plastic teddy charm. Photo by Michael Scialdone, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Headphones On
articles.dek: Addison’s debut is out. Twelve tracks, no features. Charli said trust it. I did on the walk home.
articles.imageAlt: A Sony Walkman WM-FX151. Photo: YoloBoscaiolo, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: MAYHEM
articles.dek: Fourteen tracks. Gesaffelstein on Killah. Abracadabra never left the kitchen after the Grammys.
articles.imageAlt: An empty arena from above, stage lights still on. Photo: Richard West, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Boiler Room Got Sold
articles.dek: DICE sold the webcam to Superstruct. The rooms are asking who owns the rectangle.
articles.imageAlt: A security camera on a wall. Photo: CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: You Have to Flip It
articles.dek: Physical is up 26%. Half the millennial CD buyers don’t own a player. You still buy the thing you can hold.
articles.imageAlt: A Fuji compact cassette on a ledge. You have to flip it. Photo: R. Henrik Nilsson, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Nobody Asked What to Put On
articles.dek: The club photo is a lie with good lighting. The night starts when somebody puts a record on and nobody takes a vote.
articles.imageAlt: A record spinning on a home player.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Istanbul Pulled the Lights
articles.dek: Istanbul pulled Anyma after comments called the lights satanic. Tickets were still for sale.
articles.imageAlt: An empty arena from above, stage lights still on. Photo: Richard West, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Love Deluxe
articles.dek: Sade, 1992. The record I leave on when people are still in the apartment.
articles.imageAlt: Sade Love Deluxe album cover. The record you put on when people are still in the apartment.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: They Put the Verse in Court
articles.dek: The Met still wants drill lyrics as evidence. 252 defendants in three years. A verse is not a police report.
articles.imageAlt: A wooden gavel on a courtroom bench. Photo by Joe Gratz, CC0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: You Bought a Place in Line
articles.dek: Berghain is selling tickets. DJ Mag dropped them to 21. The door can still send you home.
articles.imageAlt: Graffiti steel doors, Berlin. Photo by Michael Mayer, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Velvet Rope
articles.dek: Janet, 1997. The private record. On when the apartment still has a jacket on the chair.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: I’m Outside
articles.dek: The curb is a room. The text is the door policy. Don’t make her wait in the rain while you find a jacket.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Jersey Stayed On
articles.dek: Football shirt under the strobe. Not a costume. Same argument as the pajama pants, better colour.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: They Sold the Afters
articles.dek: Dice listed an afters. Twenty-five at the door of a kitchen. The pin used to be the ticket.
articles.imageAlt: Placeholder. Photo to come.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Inlet Knight
articles.dek: Rosco’s first full statement. Eleven tracks on cassette. A boat on actual water.
articles.imageAlt: Inlet Knight boat on the water. self-titled album artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Last Emperor
articles.dek: Sakamoto, off the movie. I put it on when the apartment needs a temperature, not a plot.
articles.imageAlt: The Last Emperor soundtrack cover. child emperor and bowing figure under a yellow banner

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: We Signed Rosco
articles.dek: Vancouver house that stays on after the room clears. We signed him. We are not going to be cool about it.
articles.imageAlt: Rosco

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Revibed Isn't Digging
articles.dek: RA this week: a shop accused of selling unlicensed vinyl rips. A checkout button is not a crate.
articles.imageAlt: Worn artist tabs in a record shop.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Born I Sat Down
articles.dek: DC producer on tour with Plum Village monks. Bars over singing bowls. The scene treats stillness like failure. He’s not buying it.
articles.imageAlt: Incense sticks in a temple bucket. Photo: Angelo Marcellano, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Still Riding
articles.dek: Molly’s Barry Can't Swim edit. Some edits feel like homework. This one stole the aux and kept it.
articles.imageAlt: Still Riding (Molly Haze Edit) glitch portrait artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: any jungle
articles.dek: L.T. Drifta, nine minutes. I played it twice before I looked at a clock.
articles.imageAlt: White vinyl on black with melting Club Copy lettering. any jungle

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Bridget In My Room
articles.dek: Door’s on the latch. Not open. Not locked. Rosco, two tracks for that hour.
articles.imageAlt: Circular photo of two silhouettes on rippled water at dusk. Bridget In My Room

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: j'adore
articles.dek: Two tracks from Rosco. Windows cracked, city going violet, a passenger you haven’t figured out yet.
articles.imageAlt: Fisheye photo of a blue car at dusk. j'adore

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Need U
articles.dek: Rosco, eight tracks. I’ve not been very good at putting anything else on.
articles.imageAlt: Neon blue line-art face on black. Need U

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Champion Sound
articles.dek: If Lions' Gate was the crossing, this is L.T. Drifta once you’re inside.
articles.imageAlt: Champion Sound circular logo artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Lions' Gate
articles.dek: One cut from L.T. Drifta. Named for the crossing you take when the night isn’t finished.
articles.imageAlt: Vancouver street at night. Rooms sign, alley wires

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Dummy
articles.dek: Portishead on a Cumberland afternoon. Rain on the glass. I still start people here.
articles.imageAlt: Rain on a window. Photo: W.carter, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: Club Copy
articles.headline: Buried Treasure
articles.dek: Flip until something holds.
articles.imageAlt: Record bins in a shop. Flip until something holds.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Part No Prompt Can Touch
articles.dek: AI can fake a finished song. It can't fake a life.
articles.imageAlt: A computer lab. Photo: Tariqabjotu, CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Summer Madness
articles.dek: Warm room. Nobody wants to leave.
articles.imageAlt: Hands framing a sunset over misty hills. Summer Madness

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: L.T. Drifta on Club Copy
articles.dek: Cumberland. Crates. Music for when people are still up.
articles.imageAlt: L.T. Drifta

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Endtroducing
articles.dek: Still the door I send people through.
articles.imageAlt: DJ Shadow Endtroducing album cover. crate diggers in a record shop

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Music Has a Long Memory
articles.dek: We forget a year. A break from 1973 still moves the furniture.
articles.imageAlt: Water from a ferry. Photo: Lomoraronald, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: Club Copy
articles.headline: Beat Tape
articles.dek: CJ Archer’s beat tape is out on Club Copy. Coat still on.
articles.imageAlt: Club Copy oval logo with star on textured gray

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: It Goes Like Nanana
articles.dek: Peggy Gou wrote the summer. The field already knew the rest.
articles.imageAlt: A rave crowd, 2008. Photo: Ildar Sagdejev, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Initial D and the Sound of Speed
articles.dek: Eurobeat, tofu runs, a music scene built on RPMs.
articles.imageAlt: A winding mountain road. Photo: jazpillaga, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Ahmad Jamal '73
articles.dek: Switzerland gave him a Rhodes. He lived in it for a year.
articles.imageAlt: Ahmad Jamal '73 album cover. pop-art portrait with hand on cheek

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Desert Played the Sad Banger
articles.dek: Four Tet, Fred again.., Skrillex. Coachella. The underground borrowed a desert.
articles.imageAlt: Desert at dusk. Photo: Kerry Bolger, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Art of Sound and Zen
articles.dek: Sit with a loop until it stops asking.
articles.imageAlt: A koi pond. Photo: Tony Webster, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Donuts
articles.dek: Put this on when your loops feel too clean.
articles.imageAlt: J Dilla Donuts album cover. smiling portrait in a Detroit D cap

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Floor Already Knew
articles.dek: Honey Dijon’s Black Girl Magic is house as a family affair. Eve, the club, a kick that doesn’t apologize.
articles.imageAlt: A disco ball. Photo: CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Easy on Your Own
articles.dek: Alvvays came back. Blue Rev, a Canadian cooler, the night drive that doesn’t end.
articles.imageAlt: A highway at night. Photo: Rick Doble, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Come for Me
articles.dek: Shygirl’s Nymph is thirty-two minutes. Club bathroom, Nike, and a record that doesn’t whisper.
articles.imageAlt: A bathroom sink. Photo: Chris McKenna, public domain.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Baddest of Them All
articles.dek: Eliza Rose took garage to the chart. The booth already knew the chant.
articles.imageAlt: A DJ booth in Munich. Photo: Arnold Jaeger Werner, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: What I Want
articles.dek: MUNA put out the record. Silk chiffon, a gay bar, and a chorus that doesn’t whisper.
articles.imageAlt: A disco ball on a ceiling. Photo: Phillip Pessar, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: American Teenager
articles.dek: Ethel Cain’s Preacher’s Daughter is the highway record. Church, motels, a girl who kept the aux.
articles.imageAlt: Supai Motel neon at night. Photo: G. Edward Johnson, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Bike, Not the Ballad
articles.dek: Rosalía dropped MOTOMAMI. Saoko, chrome, and a record that refuses the costume.
articles.imageAlt: A motorcycle. Photo: Daniel K. Gebhart, CC BY 2.5.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She Called It the Summer of Jungle
articles.dek: Nia Archives dropped Forbidden Feelingz. Bradford, Maya Angelou, and a tempo the field already missed.
articles.imageAlt: A forest path. Public domain.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Working for the Knife
articles.dek: Mitski clocked in. Laurel Hell is the record you put on before you leave the apartment.
articles.imageAlt: A kitchen sink. Photo: Larry McElhiney, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Mixtape Didn't Ask
articles.dek: FKA twigs put the club on a mixtape. The kitchen already had the aux.
articles.imageAlt: A gas station at night. Photo: Doug Davey, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: Club Copy
articles.headline: CJ Archer
articles.dek: Vancouver, the weather, and why a finished record is usually a feeling somebody refused to throw away.
articles.imageAlt: A computer desk. Photo: Dhivyabsk, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: To Hell With It
articles.dek: Bedroom. Eight tracks. The girls already had the 2-step.
articles.imageAlt: A home recording setup. Photo: Subhashish Panigrahi, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Rooms Opened
articles.dek: Eighteen months of kitchen raves walked back into a real door.
articles.imageAlt: De School dancefloor, Amsterdam. Photo: Martijn Savenije, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Oil and Chrome
articles.dek: SOPHIE died in Athens. The oil didn’t dry.
articles.imageAlt: Oil on wet asphalt. Photo: Aniskov, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Untrue
articles.dek: Burial. Rain on the glass. The club you could still hear from the kitchen.
articles.imageAlt: Rain on a window. Photo: W.carter, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Kitchen Was the Club
articles.dek: No door. No cloakroom. Somebody sent a link. You lit something and stayed on mute.
articles.imageAlt: An apartment kitchen. Photo: Gogerr, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Coat on the Chair
articles.dek: Going-out top stayed on. Coat never left the kitchen. No cloakroom to prove it.
articles.imageAlt: A wet Vancouver street at dusk. The coat walked out with nowhere to check it.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The File Is the Record
articles.dek: Pressing plant is eighteen months out. Bandcamp Friday is not a vibe. It’s the object you can still hold.
articles.imageAlt: A Fuji compact cassette on a ledge. Photo: R. Henrik Nilsson, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Wristband in the Drawer
articles.dek: You kept the first night back. You don’t wear it. The night lives in the plastic.
articles.imageAlt: A Vancouver festival wristband. Photo: Richard Eriksson, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Platforms Came Back
articles.dek: Rooms opened for real. Buffalo, a bathroom compact, and a heel that remembered 1999 before Vogue did.
articles.imageAlt: Platform heels. Photo: Stevelefrancais, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Homogenic
articles.dek: Björk. Strings and beats. The record you put on when the kitchen wants to be weather.
articles.imageAlt: Mountains reflected in a pond, Iceland. Photo: Eric Kilby, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Algorithm Is Not a Room
articles.dek: Wrapped is a brochure. For You is a corridor with no door. The night still happens in a body.
articles.imageAlt: A security camera on a wall. Photo: CC BY-SA 3.0.
